meta.title: 好想谈恋爱｜高铁座位之争
meta.title_en: A Short Film: The High-Speed Rail Seat Battle
meta.topic: 恋爱短剧 · 冲突设计与人物塑造

scenes.context: 女主的票只买到城河，被持全程票的乘客要求让座，双方僵持。
sentences: 麻烦让一下，08F 是我的。
Excuse me, seat 08F is mine.
seat 08F（08F 座位）
可你的票只买到城河。
But your ticket only goes to Chenghe.
only goes to（只到）
票到站了，座位又没下车。
The ticket expired, but the seat didn't get off.
expire（到期）
paraphrase: You're right, but the rules still side with the other person.
I was here first — shouldn't that count?
scenes.speak: Excuse me, seat 08F is mine. But your ticket only goes to Chenghe. The ticket expired, but the seat didn't get off.

scenes.context: 乘务员确认票已过站，要求让座并提示可补票。
sentences: 您的票到城河，现在已经过站了。
Your ticket is to Chenghe, and you've passed the station.
pass the station（过站）
这个位置属于这位旅客。
This seat belongs to this passenger.
belong to（属于）
我可以帮您查询后续能不能补票。
I can check if you can extend your ticket later.
extend the ticket（补票）
paraphrase: Pay to cover the remaining distance.
scenes.speak: Your ticket is to Chenghe, and you've passed the station. This seat belongs to this passenger. I can check if you can extend your ticket later.

scenes.context: 男友提出差价换一等座，先给台阶再解决问题，顺手补票。
sentences: 给你换到一等座，差价我出。
Let's move you to first class — I'll pay the difference.
first class（一等座）
这个窗边让他继续坐。
He keeps the window seat.
window seat（窗边）
先补上，省得后面又来让你算。
Extend it now so nobody makes you redo the math.
redo the math（重算）
paraphrase: Offer a face-saving way out for both sides.
scenes.speak: Let's move you to first class — I'll pay the difference. He keeps the window seat. Extend it now so nobody makes you redo the math.

scenes.context: 女主怪男友帮外人，男友解释「我说的是票又没说你」，最后分鸡腿互怼。
sentences: 我说的是票，又没说你。
I was talking about the ticket, not you.
not you（不是你）
你出钱我出鸡腿，哪里不平均？
You paid for the ticket, I pay the chicken leg — where's the imbalance?
imbalance（不平均）
都给你吧，堵住你的嘴。
It's all yours — just to shut you up.
shut you up（堵住你的嘴）
paraphrase: Sharp words, soft heart — the caring is in the actions.
Each of us chips in one thing — fair and square.
scenes.speak: I was talking about the ticket, not you. You paid for the ticket, I pay the chicken leg — where's the imbalance? It's all yours — just to shut you up.

practice: 女主的票为什么不能让？
She was there first, and her seat was claimed by someone with a longer ticket.
She asks the passenger to yield first, then offers a ticket extension.
He offers to pay for a first-class upgrade.
结尾两人的关系怎么样？
They bicker sweetly and share the chicken leg.
footer_notes: ASR 校正：转录中「成河/舱栏/舱翔」为站名音译，统一为「城河」；「小焦」按语境为昵称。
